# Overview

This document handles all **R-side preprocessing**: reading raw inputs from
`data/`, cleaning, and writing tidy outputs that `computation.qmd` consumes.

Project root is resolved with `here::here()` so paths work regardless of the
render working directory.

```{r paths}
data_dir <- here("prod-ftn", "data")
list.files(data_dir)
```

# Load

```{r load}
#| eval: false

# Example: read every CSV in data/ into a named list of data.tables.
files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
raw   <- setNames(lapply(files, fread), tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files)))
```

# Clean

```{r clean}
#| eval: false

# Example transform — replace with real cleaning logic.
tidy <- raw$main |>
  as_tibble() |>
  filter(!is.na(id)) |>
  mutate(date = ymd(date)) |>
  arrange(id, date)
```

# Summarize

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of cleaned data"
#| eval: false

tidy |>
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), list(mean = mean, sd = sd), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}")) |>
  kbl(booktabs = TRUE, digits = 3) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
```

# Export

```{r export}
#| eval: false

# Outputs for the Julia computation step.
fwrite(tidy, file.path(data_dir, "clean.csv"))
```
